save_model_to_hub: save a PyTorch model to the Huggingface Hub with config and model card generation
load_model_from_hub: load a pretrained model from the Huggingface Hub and instantiate it with config
push_model_to_hub: upload model checkpoint files to a Huggingface Hub repository in a single commit
save_model_locally: save model weights and configuration to a local directory with optional model card
generate_model_card: generate a Huggingface model card with metadata tags and library information
